name: Goblin Grunt
tuning_notes: Baseline L1 goblin for MVP. No defense; low poise with fast recovery. Amber telegraph arcs and goblin SFX. AI favors quick jabs with occasional wider slash. Targets 25–35 s TTK vs Pickaxe_T0 with intermittent stagger windows.

_meta.doc: Schema-less enemy definition used by combat runtime. All IDs are stable tokens. Numeric units: ms for timing, px for range/positions.

fields.version: Integer schema version for this data blob.
fields.id: Stable token ID for this enemy.
fields.name: Short display name.
fields.faction: Faction token used for AI aggro/ally logic.
fields.defense: Flat damage reduction applied after mitigation (>=0).

poise.recover_per_sec: Poise recovery per second while not recently broken.
poise.break_cooldown_ms: Cooldown after a break before poise can break again.

movement.speed_px_per_s: Ground speed in pixels per second.
movement.approach_dist_px: Preferred distance band to maintain from target.
movement.retreat_threshold_hp_pct: Retreat behavior if HP% <= this value.

ai.attack_weights: Roll weights for attack selection; normalized at runtime.
ai.min_attack_cooldown_ms: Lower bound of post-attack cooldown roll.
ai.max_attack_cooldown_ms: Upper bound of post-attack cooldown roll.
ai.feint_chance: Probability [0..1] to cancel before active frames.
ai.reengage_after_miss_ms: Delay before re-approach after a miss/whiff.

telegraph.flashAtMs: Relative time (negative) from windup start to fire TelegraphStartEvent; actual = windup + flashAtMs.
telegraph.color_token: VFX color token for arc flashing.
telegraph.arc_deg: Sweep arc used for telegraph and hit shape.

hitstop_ms.attacker: Hitstop applied to attacker on hit.
hitstop_ms.victim: Hitstop applied to victim on hit.

loot_table.drops: Weighted item drop entries; qty range inclusive.

acceptance_targets.stagger_window_sec: Expected effective punish window after PoiseBreak.

ecs_contract.damage_event: Fired on first frame of active window that collides.
ecs_contract.poise_break_event: Fired when poise <= 0 and not in break_cooldown.
ecs_contract.hitstop_event: Applied to both entities per hitstop_ms on hit.
